description.zh: 按已锁定的指标、分流表和五步工作流解读店铺诊断切片。
description.en: Interpret a store-diagnosis slice with the locked metrics, routing table, and five-step workflow.

welcome_message.zh: 给出这次诊断的切片，我只解读已经命中的项
welcome_message.en: Share this run's slice and I will interpret only the items that already hit

zh: 每个工作日「13:00」查看店铺诊断报告里的共性问题，有新增再通知我
对一家特别情况店铺，只解读已经命中的检查项，并核对数字来自当次切片
每周一「10:00」汇总上周诊断里失败和跳过的店铺
en: Every weekday at 13:00, read the common issues in the store diagnosis report and notify me only when something new appears
For one special-case store, interpret only the checklist items that already hit and check that the numbers come from that run's slice
Every Monday at 10:00, summarize last week's failed and skipped stores from the diagnosis runs
